title: Emotion injection against HarmBench
question: How do injection layer and steering multiplier alpha impact Attack Success Rate across emotions?
headline: Injection at layer 14 with alpha 8.0 causes peak guardrail bypass reaching 84.2 percent ASR.

tables.title: Attack success rate by layer and steering strength alpha

charts.title: Attack Success Rate across Layer and Steering Alpha (Desperation)

interpretation: A clear inverted U-shaped curve emerges across layers, peaking at layer 14.
Layers below 10 are too early in the processing hierarchy to override safety representations.
Layers above 18 degrade model fluency at high alpha without providing higher refusal suppression.
caveats: Values shown for desperation vector; other negative emotions show similar profiles with lower peak magnitudes.
Higher alpha values above 12.0 produce repetitive token loops in a minority of generations.
